Maya (VP Eng): Thanks for joining the runtime Q&A earlier. I'll capture the follow-ups here so nothing falls through the cracks.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Kernel release plan recap: small feature canaries every week, broader rollouts monthly. First canary for kernel-x next Wed. Canary traffic 1% with a 45m observation window.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-213456, start=2026-04-20T18:00:00Z, traffic=1%.
Elena (ML Eng): Can we lock perf targets for long sequences? Customers need explicit numbers for SLAs.
Maya (VP Eng): Agreed. New targets: short (<=1k): p95<=90ms, mid (1k-6k): p95<=280ms, long (6k+): p95<=600ms. We'll publish these in the SLA doc.
Sam (SRE): Observability asks: include kernel_tag, batch_size_histogram, cache_hit_rate on per-route dashboards. Alert if p95 exceeds target for 4 consecutive 1m buckets.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Batching defaults change: dynamic batch token cap will shift from 8->12 for most gen models. We'll expose `max_batch_tokens` and `batch_timeout_ms` in model config.
Elena (ML Eng): How will that affect cold-start long-context queries? Need plan to prevent tail latency regressions.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): We'll route cold long-context requests to a low-batch lane (max_batch_tokens=3) and prioritize cache-hit traffic for high-batch lanes. Cache TTLs: short=10m, session=45m.
Ivy (Product): Customers often ask whether to use 4-bit quantization for chat. Any quick guidance?
Maya (VP Eng): Action: Elena + Ravi to produce a short "quantization tradeoffs" note with measured p50/p95 and a few sample prompts. Due Fri EOD.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Canary rollback proposal: auto-rollback if p95 > baseline by 6% OR error-rate increases by 3% OR any new OOMs observed. We'll run a smoke suite (100 short + 30 long prompts) before expansion.
Sam (SRE): Ops note: kernel-x changes memory alloc patterns. We'll add a drain step 20m before canary and monitor memory pressure closely.
Ivy (Product): Console UX: please add a small banner when canaries run: "Runtime canary in progress — minimal impact expected" and link to notes.
deploy-bot: UI ticket created: ui-3789.
Maya (VP Eng): Summary/action owners: (1) Elena+Ravi: quantization note (Fri), (2) Ravi: model config flags + default table (next week), (3) Sam: dashboard alerts + canary playbook (PR Mon), (4) Console: banner (ui-3789). I'll follow up with calendar invites.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): I'll open the batching PR and link it here.
Elena (ML Eng): I'll start perf runs and post a small table of p50/p95 for representative prompts.
Sam (SRE): I'll publish the canary runbook and alert thresholds once aligned with infra.
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread and we'll re-open if new issues surface. :white_check_mark:
